mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.member_id AS memberId, b.product_id AS productId, b.board_type AS boardType, b.title AS title, b.content AS content, b.hit AS hit, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.nickname AS nickname, p.product_name AS productName FROM board b JOIN shop_member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN product p ON b.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY b.board_id DESC

SELECT b.board_id AS boardId, b.member_id AS memberId, b.product_id AS productId, b.board_type AS boardType, b.title AS title, b.content AS content, b.hit AS hit, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt, m.nickname AS nickname, p.product_name AS productName FROM board b JOIN shop_member m ON b.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN product p ON b.product_id = p.product_id WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( board_id, member_id, product_id, board_type, title, content, hit, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( seq_board.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{productId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{boardType}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, board_type = #{boardType}, product_id = #{productId}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
